trail.text:
SAMPLE INSTRUCTIONS, written for the sample run. No model was called for the event rows of this run.
You are reading one page. List every dated company event on it as JSON:
{"events": [{"ticker": "...", "company": "...", "event_type": "...", "title": "...",
  "date_text": "<date as printed>", "date": "<YYYY-MM-DD or null>", "quote": "<the sentence as printed>",
  "box": [x0, y0, x1, y1]}]}
Use only words printed on the page. If the page has no date for an event, give the printed words and null.
SMPL1 conference_presentation on later this year: “Samplebio One will present at a medical meeting later this year.”
Quote found on page: pass. The quote is printed on the page, word for word.
Citation located: pass. Every word of the quote is inside the box, and the box stays on the quote's lines.
Date read as written: pass. “later this year” is counted from the filing date (2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31); the row gives no day.
Source is more than a calendar: pass. The source is not a third-party calendar.
Event type matches the quote: pass. The quote's words (present) fit conference.
Read the same row.
